axes.name: Trace normalization
axes.regime: All N, all T, all couplings. The convention is N-agnostic — its function is to make the planar-limit bookkeeping transparent.

axes.name: Gauge group
axes.regime: All N ≥ 2. For MP (Laliberte-McPeak) model the choice is U(N) — different model, different axis.

axes.name: BFSS Hamiltonian
axes.regime: All N ≥ 2, all couplings. `g = 1` choice is WLOG per Lin-Zheng Eq. 7; reintroduce `g` via dimensional restoration `[X] = E^{1/3}·g^{2/3}`, `[P] = E^{2/3}·g^{−2/3}` when comparing with SUGRA (Axis 6).

axes.name: Dimensionless T̃
axes.regime: Applies at all T where 't Hooft limit is meaningful. The crossover T̃ ≈ 0.9 (Hagedorn/deconfinement) separates the "BH" regime (small T̃) from the "gas of D0s" regime (large T̃); conventions hold in both.

axes.name: Fermion rep
axes.regime: All BFSS-family work (no T/N regime dependence). LM model uses complex Ψ, Ψ† — disjoint axis.

axes.name: α'/coupling
axes.regime: For SUGRA comparison at low T̃ (gravity regime `T̃ ≲ 1`), α' corrections are organised as an expansion in `T̃^{2/5}` (via `a_1, a_2` of Pateloudis fit at T̃ = 0.4–1.0).

axes.name: γ^{10} hermiticity
axes.regime: Applies only in Euclidean-signature finite-T lattice MC and Wick-rotated bootstrap. Lorentzian real-time fermion kinetic term is `i ψ̄ γ^0 ∂_t ψ`; Wick rotation `t → −iτ` converts this to the Euclidean form above (depending on γ^0 ↔ γ^{10} assignment).

axes.name: Gauge generator
axes.regime: SU(N) physical states obey `C|phys⟩ = 0` (Gauss law) for all N ≥ 2, all T, all couplings. On physical states, the SUSY algebra closes as `{Q_α,Q_β} = 2 δ_{αβ} H` (the C-term drops).

axes.name: Level assignment
axes.regime: Pure bookkeeping — applies at any N, T, coupling as long as SO(9)-invariant ground state is being bootstrapped. For finite-T bootstrap (Adams 2025 / conic program) the level assignment is the same but the positivity constraint becomes KMS-exponential-cone rather than SDP (Axis 1 of meta-audit §3 row "Adams conic ⊃ SDP").

axes.name: Polyakov loop
axes.regime: Gauge-theory thermal observable; not defined in Buividovich's ungauged model. Relevant for T̃ around the deconfinement crossover T̃_c ≈ 0.9 in BFSS (Pateloudis) and T_c ≈ 0.2–0.9 μ in BMN (Bergner, depending on μ).

axes.name: BMN μ
axes.regime: BMN (mass-deformed BFSS) only; irrelevant for pure BFSS. Gravity-dual applicable for μ ≳ 0.1 (non-perturbative regime of full-BMN); bosonic-BMN (fermions removed) gives a different T_c (see §E.0.8 and meta-audit O5).

axes.name: Lattice stencil
axes.regime: Lattice MC only. Continuum limit `a → 0` recovers the canonical Euclidean action (Axis 3, Axis 15). The Wilson stencil breaks SUSY at finite `a`; Ward-identity violations scale as `O(a²)` (improved action) and extrapolate to 0 in the continuum fit.

axes.name: Metric signature
axes.regime: Lorentzian for bootstrap at T = 0 (ground state), operator-dimension comparisons, and Lin TASI pedagogical derivations. Euclidean for finite-T lattice MC (Pateloudis, Bergner), finite-T conic bootstrap (Adams 2025), and finite-T SUGRA (BM black-hole thermodynamics).

axes.name: SO(9) 16⊗16
axes.regime: Pure group theory — convention-independent. Dictates the bootstrap variable enumeration at every level; e.g. at Lin-Zheng `ℓ = 3` one needs `⟨tr (ψψ)⟩` in all five irreps.

axes.name: Euclidean prefactor
axes.regime: Euclidean lattice MC and thermal path-integral. For Lorentzian bootstrap use Axis 3 Hamiltonian form; translate via Wick rotation `S_E = −i S_L` at `t = −iτ`.

axes.name: Op. dimension
axes.regime: Near-horizon D0-brane SUGRA (Type IIA black zero-brane). Conformal dimension Δ translates to thermal two-point function scaling `⟨O(τ) O(0)⟩ ∼ τ^{-2Δ}`. `R_AdS = 2/5`, `d = 14/5`, `η = 9/5` are Lin-TASI `d = R_AdS · ...` exponents (Lin TASI `references/2508.20970.md:606–607`). Full five-tower needed for `b ≠ 0` irreps (non-BPS scalars, vectors, antisymm tensors).

typos_not_typo.description: Lin TASI "Type IIA action is *not* invariant" wording
